name: Notion
summary: A workspace for documents, wikis, databases and projects, with Notion AI. Enterprise Search, a feature of Notion AI on the Business and Enterprise plans, answers questions from the workspace and connected apps (Slack, Google Drive, Jira and others) and cites its sources. For agents it publishes a hosted MCP server (search, read, create and update content, pages and databases) that connects to a Notion workspace by OAuth only, with no non-interactive authorization yet; measured 401 with an OAuth challenge and no credentials.

agentAccess.notes: Re-measured 2026-09-23 keyless: MCP initialize at mcp.notion.com/mcp answers 401 with an identical OAuth challenge to 09-17, one scope named default, plain PKCE still advertised. The Custom Agents API (api.notion.com/v1/agents/query, public beta) answers 401 with no challenge header at all.

jobs.summary: Enterprise Search, the vendor's words: "finds answers to your questions in just seconds, searching your workspace and your connected apps" and "will always cite its sources". Business and Enterprise plans, in the Notion app; whether the MCP surface reaches it is not established. Not measured.

payments.notes: Read 2026-09-23: no surface prices a call or speaks a 402. The pricing page prices agent work in the vendor's words, 'Free to try, then $10 per 1,000 monthly Notion credits' for Custom Agents, and answers 'We currently accept all major credit and debit card brands'. Who buys credits was not read.
